question: Does FoundPose's intermediate DINOv2 layer-18 positional representation improve the published NIDS local appearance score on the consumed D15 multiscale roster?

predecessor.single_change: Use normalized block-18-of-24 patch tokens for the local appearance score while retaining final-layer FFA template selection, query-directed max-then-mean, arithmetic fusion, proposals, masks and gate.

descriptor.instance_feature: Final-layer SAM-mask-weighted mean of normalized DINOv2 patch tokens, unchanged from predecessor.

memory.template_selection: Maximum final-layer target-reference FFA cosine with lexical key tie break.

appearance.query_to_template_score: For every binary-masked block-18 query patch, take maximum cosine to all binary-masked block-18 patches of the best final-FFA template; average across query patches and clamp to [0,1].
appearance.fusion: Arithmetic mean of unchanged final-layer max FFA and block-18 local appearance.

evaluation.truth_role: Provider truth enters only post-ranking opportunity and refined IoU evaluation.

literature_motivation.finding: FoundPose reports that intermediate layer 18 of DINOv2 ViT-L/14 carries stronger positional information and improves geometrically consistent correspondences when semantic appearance is ambiguous.

forbidden_after_freeze: change DINOv2 layer, mask threshold, patch direction, template selection or score fusion
change tile geometry, proposal caps, prompt, thresholds, SAM or IoU gate
use query truth, sibling appearance, aspect ratio or image position in ranking
claim consumed D15 evidence as fresh confirmation
claim_boundary: This consumed D15 Development run can establish only whether FoundPose's intermediate-layer positional representation improves the published local appearance score on the frozen roster. It cannot regain fresh authority or establish open-set rejection, provider independence, raw-phone operation, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
